```{r}
school_data<- read.csv("data/wk2/school_year.csv", 
                         header = TRUE, 
                         sep = ",",  
                         encoding = "latin1")
```
```{r}
class(school_data)
```
提取出每个县所有科学类学生且全年级的数据
```{r}
library(stringr)

sciencestudent<- school_data %>% 
  filter(str_detect(`TestSubject`, "Science"))
```
```{r}
sciencestudent$`TestSubject`
```
```{r}
science_allgrades_student <- sciencestudent %>%
  filter(str_detect(`GradeLevel`, "All Grades"))
```
```{r}
science_allgrades_student $`GradeLevel`
```
```{r}
science_allgrades_allgroup_student <- science_allgrades_student %>%
   filter(str_detect(`StudentGroupType`,"All"))
science_allgrades_allgroup_student$`StudentGroupType`
```
```{r}
science_allgrades_allgroup_student1 <- science_allgrades_allgroup_student %>%
  filter(County != "Multiple")
View(science_allgrades_allgroup_student1)
```
优化一下：
CountyData <- StudentData %>%
  filter(
    County != "Multiple",
    TestSubject == "Science",
    StudentGroup == "All Students",
    GradeLevel == "All Grades"
  )

计算每个县所有科学类学生达到规定标准的平均百分比
```{r}
names(science_allgrades_student)
```
合并同类项
```{r}
county_total_students <- science_allgrades_allgroup_student1 %>%
  group_by(County) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalExpectedStudents = sum(Count.of.Students.Expected.to.Test, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalMetStandard = sum(CountMetStandard, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
view(county_total_students)
```
计算每个县所有科学类学生达到规定标准的平均百分比
```{r}
AverageSciencePercent <- county_total_students %>%
  #new column with average of percent of science students (in all) grades per county meeting the required standards：
  mutate(AverageSciencePercent = (TotalMetStandard/TotalExpectedStudents 
                                    )*100)
View(AverageSciencePercent)
```
country一共多少类别
```{r}
n_distinct(science_allgrades_student$County)
unique(science_allgrades_student$County)
```

读取shp文件
```{r}
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)
library(sf)
washington_map <- st_read("data/wk2/Week 2 Homework boundaries-20261015/Washington_Counties_with_Natural_Shoreline___washsh_area.shp")
View(washington_map)
```
关联数据
```{r}
 AverageSciencePercentMAP<- washington_map %>% 
  left_join(., 
            AverageSciencePercent,
            by = c( "COUNTYLABE"="County"))
```

绘制每个县百分比地图
```{r}
tmapWashington <- AverageSciencePercentMAP %>%
  # st_bbox gives the bounding x and y coordinates 
  st_bbox(.) %>% 
  #note type="osm" gives error atm - issue raised on github: https://github.com/r-tmap/tmaptools/issues/41
  tmaptools::read_osm(., type = "esri", zoom = NULL)
```
```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(AverageSciencePercentMAP) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "AverageSciencePercent",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      values = "brewer.bu_pu",
      style = "jenks"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Science students meeting standards (%)"
    )
  ) +
  tm_compass(type = "arrow", position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_title("Average Science Percent", size = 2)
```
华盛顿州的汇总
```{r}
Washington_total_students <- science_allgrades_allgroup_student1 %>%
  summarise(
    WashingtonTotalExpectedStudents = sum(Count.of.Students.Expected.to.Test, na.rm = TRUE),
    WashingtonTotalMetStandard = sum(CountMetStandard, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
view(Washington_total_students)
```
华盛顿州的平均百分比
```{r}
AverageWashingtonSciencePercent <- Washington_total_students %>%
  #new column with average of percent of science students (in all) grades per county meeting the required standards：
  mutate(AverageSciencePercent = (WashingtonTotalMetStandard/WashingtonTotalExpectedStudents 
                                    )*100)
view(AverageWashingtonSciencePercent)
```

```{r}

Total_AverageWashingtonSciencePercent <- AverageSciencePercent %>%
  mutate(
    StateAverage = 47.27245,
    Difference = AverageSciencePercent - StateAverage,
    compare = case_when(
      Difference > 0 ~ "above average",
      Difference < 0 ~ "below average",
      TRUE ~ "equal to average"
    )
  )
Total_AverageWashingtonSciencePercent %>%
  select(County, AverageSciencePercent, Difference, compare)
```
